actions.operator_match_fields_invalid: Select distinct existing non-geometry scalar fields other than id_field. An empty list merges by geometry only.
actions.operator_group_fields_invalid: Explicitly select distinct existing non-geometry scalar fields; [] means global dissolve and null groups are retained.
actions.operator_wkt_properties_invalid: Check that each WKT list item has one corresponding property object.
actions.operator_dissolve_fields_conflict: Rename conflicting fusion_id/member_count/source_id columns upstream; they are not replaced automatically.
actions.operator_input_overlap: Check polygon overlaps in the indicated layer and resolve overlaps, containment or duplicates explicitly; no automatic dissolve, deduplication or repair is performed.
actions.operator_reference_overlap: Check polygon overlaps in the indicated layer and resolve overlaps, containment or duplicates explicitly; no automatic dissolve, deduplication or repair is performed.
actions.operator_mask_invalid: Check the range layer active geometry, polygon type, validity and XY coordinates before submitting a new execution; no business identifier is required for the range layer.
actions.operator_endpoint_network_invalid: Explicitly split intersections and resolve self-intersections or overlaps before extracting nodes; no automatic splitting, deduplication or repair is performed.
actions.operator_distance_limit_invalid: Set a finite positive max_distance in horizontal CRS units before submitting a new execution.
actions.operator_source_topology_invalid: Check source self-intersections and overlaps, then normalize explicitly to meet the operator requirements; no automatic repair is performed.
actions.operator_trim_conflict: Review reference intersections at both ends and the maximum path distance, preserving a positive-length original part before submitting a new execution.
actions.configuration_missing: Start a new execution. If it fails again, ask an administrator to check configuration preparation.
actions.configuration_invalid: Check the query engine and parameters, then execute again. Contact an administrator if it persists.
actions.timeout_invalid: Ask an administrator to check the query timeout policy, then execute again.
actions.result_limit_invalid: Ask an administrator to check the query result limit policy, then execute again.
actions.query_template_invalid: Check that table parameters use unqualified parameter names. If a platform-bound query still fails, contact an administrator.
actions.relation_binding_invalid: Select a valid table from the query engine for each table parameter, then execute again.
actions.authorization_invalid: Check your data read permission, then start a new execution to obtain fresh authorization.
actions.engine_unavailable: Check the engine connection and read permission, then execute again.
actions.engine_mismatch: Use the same engine for the input tables, output table, and query, then execute again.
actions.query_syntax_invalid: Check the syntax for the selected engine and query language, then execute again.
actions.column_not_found: Check the selected tables, column names, and aliases, then review query diagnostics before executing again.
actions.table_not_found: Check the table or view name, schema, and read permissions. For a temporary view, confirm it was created during this execution.
actions.ambiguous_column: Qualify shared column names with a table name or alias, such as a.id.
actions.function_or_operator_not_found: Check the function name, argument count and types, and the types on both sides of the operator.
actions.division_by_zero: Check for zero divisors. Filter them or use NULLIF(divisor, 0), according to the intended calculation.
actions.type_mismatch: Check column and parameter types and explicit casts, then execute again.
actions.permission_denied: Ask an administrator to check your data authorization and the engine connection account permissions.
actions.connection_failed: Check engine availability, network connectivity, and connection settings, then execute again.
actions.timeout: Review the query plan and data volume; optimize the query or adjust the permitted timeout before executing again.
actions.connection_acquisition_timeout: Retry later. If this recurs, check concurrency, the pool limit, and database connectivity.
actions.sql_execution_timeout: Check database lock waits, the query plan, and the amount of data.
actions.execution_budget_invalid: Remove the execution-time override or keep it within the platform budget.
actions.cancelled: Start a new execution if you still need the query results.
actions.resource_exhausted: Reduce the query size or ask an administrator to check engine resources, then execute again.
actions.query_failed: Copy the diagnostic information for an administrator to investigate by execution ID.
actions.result_invalid: Copy the diagnostic information for an administrator to check result processing.
actions.database_required: Select the target database or collection in data resources, then execute again.
actions.local_read_unsupported: Use a local physical database, built-in functions and supported read-only Cypher. Procedures, external sources, composite databases and uncovered syntax are not supported.
actions.data_protection_required: Ask a security administrator to check masking rules, validity and synchronization, and whether the operation supports the required protection.
actions.protection_computed_output_unsupported: Read the protected fields directly so the system can mask them. A plaintext grant does not remove this restriction.
actions.protection_lineage_unverified: Use a supported operation with verifiable data origins. For queries, try direct fields from one table; if it still fails, ask an administrator to check engine support.
actions.protection_role_choice_unavailable: Refresh selectable masking methods, choose again and rerun. Expired live results also require a fresh query. This does not indicate missing data-read permission.
actions.protection_not_ready: Wait for protection enrollment and rule synchronization to complete, then retry. If it remains unready, ask a security administrator to check synchronization.
actions.protection_expired: Ask a security administrator to renew data protection or set permanent validity. Retry after the rules synchronize.
actions.protection_not_yet_valid: Wait until the protection rules take effect, or ask a security administrator to check their start time.
actions.protection_schema_mismatch: Ask an administrator to update metadata and reconfirm the protection rules. Execute again after synchronization completes.
actions.protection_operation_unsupported: Use an execution method that supports these protection rules, or ask an administrator to check protection support for this engine and operation.
actions.json_invalid: Check the JSON format and input type for the target column.
actions.array_invalid: Check the array element type, dimensions and format.
actions.bytes_invalid: Check that binary columns receive byte values.
actions.table_write_failed: Check target constraints, connectivity and write permissions, and investigate using the execution ID.
actions.execution_failed: Use the execution ID to check execution records and relevant resources.
actions.target_exists: Choose another output file name or location, then run again.
actions.operator_input_invalid: Check the source layer type, active geometry, fields and identifiers against the operator requirements, then submit a new execution.
actions.operator_reference_invalid: Check the reference geometry, CRS and unique non-null identifiers before submitting a new execution.
actions.operator_field_conflict: Manually rename source field {field} upstream before submitting a new execution; it is not renamed or overwritten automatically.
actions.operator_geometry_field_conflict: Manually rename source active geometry column {field} upstream before submitting a new execution.
actions.operator_number_invalid: Enter a finite real number, allowing positive, zero or negative values; do not use booleans, strings, nulls, arrays or non-finite values.
actions.operator_nonnegative_number_required: Enter a finite non-negative number, allowing zero; do not use booleans, strings, nulls, arrays or non-finite values.
actions.operator_boolean_required: Select a boolean value, true or false; do not use numbers, strings, nulls, arrays or other types.
actions.operator_enum_invalid: Select an allowed value for this parameter before running again.
actions.operator_number_array_invalid: Check every distances array element; valid zero, negative and duplicate distances remain allowed.
actions.operator_positive_integer_required: Set the parameter to an integer greater than zero before submitting a new execution.
actions.operator_positive_number_required: Set a finite positive tolerance in source CRS units; it is not converted to metres automatically.
actions.operator_projected_crs_required: Explicitly reproject both inputs to the same suitable projected CRS before submitting a new execution.
actions.operator_crs_mismatch: Explicitly align the projected CRSs; equal units alone do not make the CRSs equivalent.
actions.operator_crs_invalid: Explicitly align both projected CRSs and horizontal units before submitting a new execution.
actions.operator_geometry_invalid: Run geometry checks first, explicitly repair confirmed issues, and verify the result meets the operator requirements before submitting a new execution.
actions.operator_overlay_fields_conflict: Manually rename conflicting source fields upstream; fields are not suffixed, replaced or discarded automatically.
actions.operator_output_fields_invalid: Set valid_field and reason_field explicitly to non-empty strings without surrounding whitespace, distinct from each other and every source column; no automatic renaming or replacement.

actions.operator_input_invalid: Prepare the source explicitly with unique column names; reject Z/M and non-finite coordinates, without skipping bad rows or substituting zero bounds for EMPTY.
actions.operator_crs_invalid: Set the correct two-dimensional CRS explicitly first; retain original XY and units, without projection, conversion, axis swapping or antimeridian wrapping.
actions.operator_geometry_field_conflict: Rename active geometry column {field} manually first; ordinary result columns are updated, without automatic renaming or geometry replacement.

reasons.operator_input_invalid: Multipart split requires valid finite XY Point/LineString/Polygon or their Multi types and a unique non-null id_field; GeometryCollection, NULL, EMPTY and empty parts are rejected.
reasons.operator_crs_invalid: Multipart split requires a known two-dimensional geographic or projected CRS; unknown, geocentric, 3D and compound CRS are rejected.
reasons.operator_field_conflict: Fixed split field {field} conflicts with an input field.

actions.operator_input_invalid: Prepare the source and id_field explicitly: unique column names and unique non-null non-geometry scalar identifiers; reject Z/M without recursive collection expansion or dropping empty rows.
actions.operator_crs_invalid: Set the correct two-dimensional CRS explicitly first; preserve original XY and units, without projection, conversion or axis swapping.
actions.operator_field_conflict: Rename field {field} manually upstream first, without replacing original attributes or automatic renaming.

reasons.operator_input_invalid: Vertex extraction requires valid finite XY Point/LineString/Polygon or Multi types and a unique non-null id_field; GeometryCollection, NULL, EMPTY and empty parts/rings are rejected.
reasons.operator_crs_invalid: Vertex extraction requires a known two-dimensional geographic or projected CRS; unknown, geocentric, 3D and compound CRS are rejected.
reasons.operator_field_conflict: Fixed vertex field {field} conflicts with an input field.

actions.operator_input_invalid: Prepare the source and id_field explicitly with unique column names and unique non-null non-geometry scalar identifiers; reject Z/M without dropping empty rows. Closing and repeated coordinates are retained separately, without computing network nodes.
actions.operator_crs_invalid: Set the correct two-dimensional CRS explicitly first; retain original XY and units without projection, conversion or axis swapping.
actions.operator_field_conflict: Rename field {field} manually upstream first to preserve attributes; vertex_id is unique only within this result, without automatic replacement or renaming.

reasons.operator_input_invalid: Geometry checking and repair require a GeoDataFrame with an active geometry and finite XY coordinates, without Z/M.
reasons.operator_output_fields_invalid: Geometry checking output fields are invalid, identical or conflict with source columns.

actions.operator_input_invalid: Check the input type, active geometry and finite XY coordinates; NULL/EMPTY and unknown CRS retain their existing rules. Invalid geometries may still be checked or explicitly repaired, without automatic projection.
actions.operator_output_fields_invalid: Set valid_field and reason_field explicitly to non-empty strings without surrounding whitespace, distinct from each other and every source column; no automatic renaming or replacement.

reasons.operator_input_invalid: The source lines, identifiers or projected CRS do not meet the input requirements.
reasons.operator_reference_invalid: The reference lines, identifiers or projected CRS do not meet the input requirements.
reasons.operator_crs_invalid: The two layers must use the same projected CRS.
reasons.operator_positive_number_required: Snapping tolerance must be a finite positive number.
reasons.operator_distance_limit_invalid: The maximum extension distance must be a finite positive number.

actions.operator_input_invalid: Check the source XY lines, known projected CRS, and unique non-null identifiers in id_field.
actions.operator_reference_invalid: Check the reference XY lines, known projected CRS, and unique non-null identifiers in reference_id_field.
actions.operator_crs_invalid: Explicitly reproject both layers to the same projected CRS.
actions.operator_positive_number_required: Set tolerance to a finite positive number in the projected CRS units.
actions.operator_distance_limit_invalid: Set max_distance to a finite positive number in the projected CRS units.

reasons.operator_input_invalid: The input layer needs an active geometry column with valid, non-empty lines and finite XY coordinates.

actions.operator_input_invalid: Check the active geometry of input_gdf. Provide valid LineString or MultiLineString geometries and remove NULL, empty geometries or parts, Z/M dimensions, and non-finite coordinates.

reasons.operator_input_invalid: The reference-snapping source requires an active geometry with valid finite XY coordinates, without Z/M.
reasons.operator_reference_invalid: The reference-snapping reference requires an active geometry with valid finite XY coordinates, without Z/M.
reasons.operator_crs_invalid: Reference snapping requires the same known projected CRS and matching finite positive horizontal units.
reasons.operator_nonnegative_number_required: Reference-snapping tolerance must be a finite non-negative number, not a boolean.

actions.operator_input_invalid: Check the source GeoDataFrame and active geometry for valid finite XY coordinates; NULL/EMPTY remain unchanged. Repair explicitly when needed.
actions.operator_reference_invalid: Check the reference GeoDataFrame and active geometry for valid finite XY coordinates; NULL/EMPTY provide no vertices, and an empty reference leaves input unchanged.
actions.operator_crs_invalid: Reproject explicitly to the same known projected CRS with matching horizontal axis units. Tolerance uses the original units; no automatic projection.
actions.operator_nonnegative_number_required: Set a finite non-negative tolerance in CRS units. Zero does not move vertices; positive tolerance accepts only a strictly smaller original distance.

develop_runtime.description: Registers the Develop module and task provider without data access permissions.

meta_runtime.name: Meta Platform Runtime
meta_runtime.description: Registers the Meta module and task provider without user business permissions.

orchestrator_runtime.description: Discovers task providers and registers Orchestrator runtime capabilities.

portal_runtime.name: Portal Platform Runtime
portal_runtime.description: Registers the Portal module and sends runtime heartbeats without user or tenant business permissions.

prometheus_runtime.name: Metrics Collector Runtime

administrator.name: Tenant Access Administrator

copilot_runtime.name: Copilot Execution Runtime

document_runtime.name: Document Derivation Runtime

duckdb_runtime.name: DuckDB Federated Query Runtime
duckdb_runtime.description: Lets DuckDB consume a single execution authorization and obtain exact engine access within a tenant.

geopython_runtime.name: GeoPython Derivation Runtime
geopython_runtime.description: Lets GeoPython workloads create spatial-data-derived artifacts within a tenant.

graph_runtime.name: Knowledge Graph Execution Runtime
graph_runtime.description: Lets Graph invoke knowledge graph extraction and read business entities, entity relations, and engine information.

manager_runtime.name: Data Management Execution Runtime
manager_runtime.description: Lets Manager inspect metadata, use engines, start transfer tasks, and consume execution authorization within a tenant.

model3d_runtime.name: 3D Model Derivation Runtime
model3d_runtime.description: Lets Model3D workloads create 3D-model-derived artifacts within a tenant.

model_runtime.name: Data Modeling Execution Runtime
model_runtime.description: Lets Model read data standards and engine descriptors and consume modeling execution authorization.

monitor_runtime.name: Runtime Monitoring Runtime
monitor_runtime.description: Lets Monitor read metadata scan tasks and write tenant audit events.

ontology_runtime.name: Ontology Projection Runtime
ontology_runtime.description: Lets Ontology consume exact internal task execution authorization without business engine access.

pointcloud_runtime.name: Point Cloud Derivation Runtime
pointcloud_runtime.description: Lets PointCloud workloads create point-cloud-derived artifacts within a tenant.

quality_runtime.name: Data Quality Execution Runtime
quality_runtime.description: Lets Quality read metadata, data standards, and materialization information and consume quality execution authorization.

security_runtime.name: Data Protection Runtime
security_runtime.description: Lets Security read tenant memberships and metadata security facts to maintain data-protection projections.

service_runtime.name: Data Service Execution Runtime

spark_runtime.name: Spark Execution Runtime
spark_runtime.description: Lets Spark workloads read engines available within the current tenant.

standard_runtime.name: Data Standard Execution Runtime
standard_runtime.description: Lets Standard read tenant memberships, process standard documents, and update model standard references.

transfer_runtime.name: Data Transfer Execution Runtime
transfer_runtime.description: Lets Transfer use engines and metadata and consume user-derived data transfer authorization.

ai_user.name: AI User
ai_user.description: Uses Agent sessions and runs, plus Copilot execution capabilities.

asset_consumer.name: Asset Consumer
asset_consumer.description: Browses published assets, requests access, views service endpoints while authorization is active, and submits ratings.

asset_manager.name: Asset Manager
asset_manager.description: Manages asset catalogs, entries, access requests, and ratings.

asset_runtime.name: Asset Discovery Runtime
asset_runtime.description: Lets Asset read discoverable Meta, Service, Standard, and Develop resources within a tenant.

catalog_runtime.name: Catalog Sync Runtime
catalog_runtime.description: Lets Catalog read tenant-scoped Meta changes and Standard semantic summaries.

auditor.name: Tenant Auditor

data_architect.name: Data Architect

data_engineer.name: Data Engineer

data_steward.name: Data Steward

data_viewer.name: Data Viewer

develop_runtime.name: Develop Execution Runtime
develop_runtime.description: Consumes user-derived execution authorizations and reads masked runtime descriptors without independent data permissions.

governance_manager.name: Governance Manager
governance_manager.description: Manages data standards, quality rules, check tasks, and quality issues.

security_manager.name: Data Security Manager
security_manager.description: Manages sensitive data definitions, protected resources, protection rules, and raw-value access reviews tenant-wide.

graph_engineer.name: Graph Engineer
graph_engineer.description: Manages ontologies, graphs, build tasks, analysis, and reviews.

monitoring_operator.name: Monitoring Operator

meta_runtime.name: Metadata Scan Runtime
meta_runtime.description: Reads tenant engine connections for metadata scans and writes tenant audit events.

orchestrator_runtime.name: Task Orchestration Runtime
orchestrator_runtime.description: Calls task providers and resolves execution authorization subjects without independent data permissions.

portal_runtime.name: Asset Portal Aggregation Runtime
portal_runtime.description: Reads tenant service endpoint projections only after user asset authorization is confirmed, without independent asset access.

service_publisher.name: Service Publisher
service_publisher.description: Reads data and the Meta catalog, and manages service definitions and external registrations.
